notes.title: Update v0.8.2
notes.content:
Additions:

New control for aiming, Player will now move relative to the camera when aiming, rather than towards the mouse positions

[list]
[*] Added - nettles
[*] Added - Berry bush
[*] Added - crafting benches for, generic, herbal, weapons and medical crafting recipes
[*] Added - running animations for Animals, Bear, Deer male, Deer female and wolf
[*] Added - animals will now go from walking to running when running from player, or running to player
[*] Added - Crafting timer for each crafting item as well as crafting button animation
[*] Added - Looting vehicles for scrap
[*] Added - Animation for vehicles bonnet opening
[*] Added - Icons for backpacks
[*] Added - Sound effect for swinging weapon
[*] Added - Sound effect for hitting organic
[*] Added - Sound effect for hitting inorganic
[*] Added - New weapons
[/list]
	    - Weapon Bat
	  - Weapon Bat w/nails
	  - Weapon Bat w/saw blade
	  - Weapon AK_Upgraded
	  - Weapon M4_Upgraded
	  - Weapon UMP_Upgraded
[list]
[*] Added - New crafting recipe
[/list]
	- Bat w/Nails
	- Bat w/Saw blade
	- Metal wire
	- herbal tea
	- Crowbar w/Stakes

Changed:
[list]
[*] Changed - Re-done all the building icons
[*] Changed - Added large mountain/cliff area with a large lake.
[*] Changed - Changed the Crafting UI
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed - Reload animation after just firing, this would break the walk animation
[*] Fixed - Reload animation going to idle animation when player still aiming, it will now go to the aiming animation correctly
[*] Fixed - bug that allow you to craft even if you did not have space.
[*] Fixed - Flash light range and angle
[*] Fixed - Pickup animation no longer loops, and stops when you stop holding down the pickup key
[*] Fixed - There was a camera issue, the camera was slightly angled to the left and was causing some shooting and movement issues being slightly off.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.8.1
notes.content:
[h1]Change list:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Settings menu now working

[*] pickup animation
[*] Rifle equip animation
[*] Rifle unequip animation
[*] Forward momentum when swinging weapon/melee

[*] Left mouse button now attacks and player faces the mouse position
[*] Damage image screen now shows after 50% health damage
[*] Idle animation has been changed
[/list]
